title: Was Randy shown alien technology as a reverse-engineering litmus test

tellings.quote: was Randy shown this technology as a weapons expert to see if he could figure it out reverse engineer it on the spot as a litmus test to see how an exposed adversary might react

plain: A guest named Randy Anderson, a weapons expert, says he saw alien technology at a US military base, and Michels wonders whether he was shown it on purpose. The test, as Michels imagines it, would be whether Anderson could work out how the object functioned on the spot, as a way of seeing how an enemy might react if it ever got such technology. This is Michels's own guess, offered as a question rather than as anything Anderson was told.
